comparator.name: Biomedical Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: Permitted separate revisit on 13 November 2026. Current BA-BW programme and 40 module API responses were read with 12 November imports: 34 module objects and six actual null responses. The current allocation remains 180 EC: thirteen credited year-1 units total 60; twelve credited ordinary year-2 units total 60; year-3 Oncology 9, standard Student Research Project 19 and Communication in Science 3 at 2 total 30, plus genuine open study 30. BAST1 has a separately assessed 5-EC year assignment; integrated themes, exchange-only 2+2 EC and null academic-attitude/PPP entries are not counted as extra requirements. Current minor text confirms 30 EC of choice from 2026–2027. The optional extended project replaces standard 19 plus 15 choice EC with 34, and a separate elective project carries 30 EC with distinct subject, techniques and department; these options are not added together. The current Human Pathology 311200260Y admission field explicitly requires completed Human Biology, Biomolecules, Cellular Communication, Medical Genetics, Immunology, Physiology Basic Concepts and the course printed as Physiology Advanved Cocepts. No Physiology Advanced Concepts unit is present in current ordinary programme membership. Current Physiology Basic Concepts and Hormones and the Nervous System provide no inspected explicit replacement/equivalence. Numerical closure does not resolve that progression condition. Other current entry conditions were read: Immunology before Infectious Agents and Immunity; Introduction to the Neurosciences before Hormones; CiS1 before CiS2; CiS1/2 before CiS3; Molecular Biology, Cellular Communication and Immunology before Oncology; all year-1/year-2 examinations and written BIC project agreement at least four weeks before the standard research project. Introduction to R recommendations are not promoted to completed-course prerequisites. Choose Your Future retains its annual minor-registration wording; future dates are not extrapolated. Actual LUMC programme and clinical-epidemiology pages are now readable through direct retrieval. The old 2026–2027 year-overview PDF URL returns 404. Current planning-index web content supplies MyTimetable access and yearly-overview headings, not the missing prerequisite correspondence. Official-domain searches and the located older 2025–2026 OER did not yield an inspected applicable amendment; partial cached OER text was followed by a system-malfunction response, so no full current formal-document verification is claimed. Other universities’ rules and archived 2025–2026 catalogue content do not amend Leiden’s current requirement. The selected human-facing current catalogue URL remains primary; direct HTML is a catalogue shell and current academic data were verified from its programme/module APIs. The current public Leiden overview is also inspected through web retrieval. No silent exemption, retired extra course, exchange-only 5-EC Pathology substitute, future delivery or final UCR no-match is inferred. Positive UCR concepts, feasible provisional schedules, bounded alignments and unchanged description text remain research pending this academic gate.

Design and Analysis of Biomedical Studies

Published entry conditions include Human Biology, Biomolecules, Cellular Communication, Medical Genetics, Immunology, Physiology Basic Concepts and Physiology Advanced Concepts. The last prerequisite is absent from the current programme; its applicable replacement or removal remains unresolved.
Required module after completed Molecular Biology, Cellular Communication and Immunology.

Required individual supervised biomedical research. All first- and second-year examinations must be passed. Written project agreement must reach the internship committee at least four weeks before the start.
Required scientific writing, peer review and research poster; Communication in Science 1 and 2 must be completed.
Genuine 30-EC third-year choice space from 2026–2027: a full minor, half-minor with electives or project extension, or a separate elective project. Specific subjects are not compulsory.

exception.reason: The current published curriculum accounts for 180 EC, but Human Pathology explicitly requires completed Physiology Advanced Concepts, a course absent from current ordinary programme membership. The inspected current programme, physiology and hormone modules and reasonable official alternatives do not supply an applicable correction or equivalence. That requirement must be reconciled before a complete UCR comparison can be verified.
exception.curriculumContext: Current allocation: 60 EC in year 1, 60 EC in year 2, and 30 EC compulsory plus 30 EC open study in year 3. Research, Oncology, communication and other independently verified entry conditions are retained. The unresolved Pathology prerequisite prevents certification of a valid complete pathway. Three positive UCR concepts, schedules and alignments remain provisional research; they are neither active final comparisons nor a no-match.

audience.programmeDescription: Biomedical Sciences at Leiden studies the healthy and diseased human body, from molecules and cells to organ systems and clinical research. It combines biological mechanisms, laboratory work, quantitative research methods and scientific communication.
audience.comparisonExplanation: A complete UCR comparison is awaiting clarification of a Leiden course-entry requirement. The published curriculum allocation is shown below, including the 19-EC research project and 30 EC of elective study. Relevant UCR biomedical, population-health and quantitative options have been identified, but their comparison cannot yet be finalised.

curriculum.limitation: The published allocation totals 180 EC: 60 EC in each of the first two years and 30 EC of compulsory study plus 30 EC of choice in year three. This is not yet a fully verified degree pathway: Human Pathology requires Physiology Advanced Concepts, which is absent from the current programme. Its applicable replacement or removal still needs confirmation.
